accountLabel.description: The account's short command when it has one, else its ref.

title.description: The Session Title: the name the user gave it, else the host's title, else the first prompt; may be empty.

project.description: The Project: the git repository root of the working directory (worktrees folded in), else the folder.

projectName.description: Its folder name, with the parent folder when two Projects share one.

cwd.description: The working directory the session ran in; may be empty.

cwdGone.description: True when that folder no longer exists.

startedAt.description: ISO time; empty when the record gives none.

updatedAt.description: Last activity, ISO time; empty when the record gives none.

script.description: A Script Session: started by a script, an SDK or another agent.

parent.description: For a subagent session: the session id that started it.

preview.description: The first prompt on one line (at most 240 characters), when it says more than the title.

snippet.description: Where the words matched, about 40 characters each side.

foundIn.description: `tools` when the words matched only its tool output (--tools).

live.description: True while the session is running.

resumeCommand.description: The command that resumes it in the account that holds it.

continueCommand.description: `cd <cwd> && <resumeCommand>` (only the resume command when the folder is gone): continue it where it was.

reference.description: The Session Reference in English: one sentence that points another AI at the session and its record.

group.description: With --group: the key of the group the session is listed under.

sessions.description: Sessions best match first (relevance times recency), or newest first without words; subagent sessions are counted in their parent. Matches found only in tool output (--tools) come last.

total.description: All matching sessions; more than `sessions` when --limit or --offset cut the list.

state.description: `building`: the History Index is still reading files (what is built answers already); `off`: config `history.index` is false or the index file could not be opened, so only titles and folders are searched; `unavailable`: this Node has no `node:sqlite`.

progress.description: Files read in the current build of the History Index, and how many it has to read.

failed.description: Record files that could not be read.

note.description: Why the account has no sessions or could not be listed, in plain words.

reason.description: `note` as a code: no record files, records without a conversation, a folder that could not be read, or a tool sideby reads no history for.

items.description: How many sessions sideby read from one account.

problems.description: An account or file that could not be read, and what to do; never aborts the listing.

key.description: The Project path, category name, Account ref, Family id or day (`today`, `yesterday`, `week`, `month`, `older`); empty for sessions without one.

sessions.description: Matching sessions in the group, collapsed or not.

collapsed.description: True when its sessions were left out of `sessions` (folded in the Panel).

groups.description: With --group (not `none`): every group of the matches, best first and the one without a key last; days in time order.

label.description: What the categories are called on screen; "Category" when the plugin gives none.

from.description: The plugin that sorts Projects into them.

categories.description: Set when a plugin sorts Projects into Project Categories (ADR-0044).

toolOutputMore.description: With --tools: more sessions matched in tool output than the page holds; a larger --limit lists them.

command.description: Run it after the user agrees: it shows the plan and exits 10; then --yes.

installed.description: The skill's version; null when it has none.

command.description: `sideby update`, which updates the skill with sideby: run it after the user agrees; it shows the plan and exits 10, then --yes.

_notice.description: Not the answer to the task: mention it briefly afterwards and offer to update.
